title: n8n Python Code node fails after 2.0 because _input and dot access no longer work
symptoms: Python code that reads _input fails after the upgrade
item.json.field dot access fails where it worked on Pyodide
Python Code node does not run without the n8nio/runners sidecar
cause: n8n 2.0 removed the Pyodide Python node. Native Python runs on task runners, exposes only _items and _item, and accepts bracket access only.
fix: Rewrite Python code to use _items or _item with bracket notation, and run the n8nio/runners sidecar.
affected: n8n 2.0 and later; native Python available from 1.111.0
